name: Cool / Temperate
examples: Canberra, inland NSW highlands, Tasmania, Victorian high country
notes: Shorter warm season and meaningful frost risk. Warm-season crops generally wait until frost danger passes.

name: Temperate
examples: Sydney, coastal NSW, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth
notes: Broad planting window with cool-season and warm-season crops both possible across the year.

name: Subtropical
notes: Long warm season; many crops perform best outside the hottest and wettest periods.

name: Tropical
notes: Planting is strongly influenced by wet and dry seasons rather than frost.

name: Arid / Semi-arid
notes: Heat, water availability and extreme temperature swings are major planting constraints.
